archetypes.name: dyn-ci-retry
archetypes.rationale: Changed retry predicates and one-shot retry behavior for the claude-ci fixer.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the ci_agentic_fix retry predicate and _run_cycle integration. Confirm the retry is still bounded to one extra launch, handles missing and zero-byte output, preserves exit-124 behavior, and does not mask non-transient non-empty failures. Check the warning text records the first resolved rc and trigger reason accurately. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
